transformations.source:
FUNCTION DecimalToBinary(n):
    IF n == 0 THEN RETURN STRING("0")
    
    binary_str <- EMPTY STRING
    WHILE n > 0 DO
        remainder <- n MOD 2
        binary_str <- string(remainder) + binary_str
        n <- n DIV 2
    END WHILE
    
    RETURN binary_str
END FUNCTION
